answer:
The bus that runs along Oxford Street in Halifax and finishes at the transit‑terminal right next to the Walmart‑Sobeys complex is **Halifax Transit Route 1 (Spring Garden)**.

- **Route**: **1 (Spring Garden)**  
- **Key stops** on Oxford: Oxford St / Bayers Rd, Oxford St / Almon St, Oxford St / Summit St, Oxford St / North St, etc.  
- **Terminal**: Terminates at the **Mumford Terminal**, situated at the southwest corner of the Walmart‑Sobeys complex in the Oakdale area.  

So if you’re heading up the slope of Oxford, hop on Route 1 — it will take you right up to that mall‑adjacent terminal.
